entities.name: Jasem Delavari
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jasem Delavari was an Iranian amateur boxer who competed in the Super Heavyweight division at the 2006 Asian Games winning the bronze medal in a lost bout against Uzbekistan's eventual gold medalist Rustam Saidov 11-31.
